title: De-identified aggregate research — studies exception
query: For our annual program evaluation, can I get aggregate graduation rates by ethnicity?

consultation.query: For our annual program evaluation, can I get aggregate graduation rates by ethnicity?

decision.query: For our annual program evaluation, can I get aggregate graduation rates by ethnicity?
decision.llm_response:
Allowed under 34 CFR § 99.31(b)(1) (de-identified records).
Confirm: removal of all PII has been done with a reasonable de-identification determination accounting for other reasonably-available information.

advisor_reply:
Yes, you can access aggregate graduation rates by ethnicity for program evaluation purposes. The data must be fully de-identified, ensuring no individual student can be recognized. Please confirm with our data analytics team that all personally identifiable information has been removed before generating the report.

[Advisor follow-up note for internal records: Document this request and verification process per our FERPA compliance tracking protocols.]
